changeSet.author: zakaria el kotb
changeSet.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;

changeSet.author: zakaria el kotb
changeSet.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm;

changeSet.author: zakaria el kotb
changeSet.sql: create table revinfo ( id integer generated by default as identity, timestamp bigint not null, email varchar(255), ip_address varchar(45), primary key (id) );
create index idx_revinfo_timestamp on revinfo (timestamp);
create index idx_revinfo_email on revinfo (email);

rollback.sql: drop table if exists revinfo cascade;

changeSet.author: zakaria el kotb
changeSet.sql: create table users ( id uuid not null, full_name varchar(255) not null, cin varchar(255) not null, phone_number varchar(255) not null, email varchar(255) not null unique, address varchar(255), manager_id uuid, password varchar(255) not null, roles varchar(255) not null, enabled boolean not null, failed_login_attempts integer not null, primary key (id) );
alter table users add constraint fk_users_manager foreign key (manager_id) references users (id);
create index idx_users_manager_id on users (manager_id);
create index idx_users_enabled on users (enabled);
create index idx_users_full_name_trgm on users using gin (full_name gin_trgm_ops);
create index idx_users_email_trgm on users using gin (email gin_trgm_ops);
create index idx_users_cin_trgm on users using gin (cin gin_trgm_ops);

rollback.sql: drop table if exists users cascade;

changeSet.author: zakaria el kotb
changeSet.sql: create table users_audit ( id uuid not null, rev integer not null, revtype smallint, full_name varchar(255), cin varchar(255), phone_number varchar(255), email varchar(255), address varchar(255), manager_id uuid, roles varchar(255), enabled boolean, primary key (rev, id) );
alter table users_audit add constraint fk_users_audit_revinfo foreign key (rev) references revinfo (id);
create index idx_users_audit_rev on users_audit (rev);

rollback.sql: drop table if exists users_audit cascade;

changeSet.author: zakaria el kotb
changeSet.sql: create table refresh_tokens ( id uuid not null, token varchar(255) not null unique, user_id uuid not null, expires_at timestamp(6) with time zone not null, revoked boolean not null, primary key (id) );
create index idx_refresh_tokens_user_id on refresh_tokens (user_id);

rollback.sql: drop table if exists refresh_tokens cascade;

changeSet.author: zakaria el kotb
changeSet.sql: create table auth_audit ( id uuid not null, event_type varchar(20) not null check (event_type in ('LOGIN','LOGOUT','TOKEN_REFRESH')), success boolean not null, email varchar(255), ip_address varchar(45), user_agent varchar(512), occurred_at timestamp(6) with time zone not null, primary key (id) );
create index idx_auth_audit_email on auth_audit (email);
create index idx_auth_audit_ip_address on auth_audit (ip_address);
create index idx_auth_audit_event_type on auth_audit (event_type);
create index idx_auth_audit_occurred_at on auth_audit (occurred_at);

rollback.sql: drop table if exists auth_audit cascade;

changeSet.author: zakaria el kotb
changeSet.sql: create table notification ( id uuid not null, recipient_id uuid not null, recipient_email varchar(255), channel varchar(20) not null check (channel in ('MAIL','APPLICATION')), category varchar(100), reference_key varchar(255), subject varchar(255) not null, body varchar(4000) not null, html boolean not null, status varchar(20) not null check (status in ('PENDING','SENT','READ','FAILED')), attempts integer not null, next_attempt_at timestamp(6) with time zone not null, last_error varchar(1000), created_at timestamp(6) with time zone not null, sent_at timestamp(6) with time zone, read_at timestamp(6) with time zone, primary key (id) );
create index idx_notification_recipient on notification (recipient_id);
create index idx_notification_dispatch on notification (channel, status, next_attempt_at);

rollback.sql: drop table if exists notification cascade;

changeSet.author: zakaria el kotb
changeSet.sql: create table notification_audit ( id uuid not null, rev integer not null, revtype smallint, recipient_id uuid, recipient_email varchar(255), channel varchar(20) check (channel in ('MAIL','APPLICATION')), category varchar(100), reference_key varchar(255), subject varchar(255), body varchar(4000), html boolean, status varchar(20) check (status in ('PENDING','SENT','READ','FAILED')), attempts integer, next_attempt_at timestamp(6) with time zone, last_error varchar(1000), created_at timestamp(6) with time zone, sent_at timestamp(6) with time zone, read_at timestamp(6) with time zone, primary key (rev, id) );
alter table notification_audit add constraint fk_notification_audit_revinfo foreign key (rev) references revinfo (id);
create index idx_notification_audit_rev on notification_audit (rev);

rollback.sql: drop table if exists notification_audit cascade;

changeSet.author: zakaria el kotb
changeSet.sql: create table change_freeze ( id uuid not null, frozen boolean not null, updated_at timestamp(6) with time zone, updated_by uuid, primary key (id) );

rollback.sql: drop table if exists change_freeze cascade;

changeSet.author: zakaria el kotb
changeSet.sql: create table change_freeze_audit ( id uuid not null, rev integer not null, revtype smallint, frozen boolean, updated_at timestamp(6) with time zone, updated_by uuid, primary key (rev, id) );
alter table change_freeze_audit add constraint fk_change_freeze_audit_revinfo foreign key (rev) references revinfo (id);

rollback.sql: drop table if exists change_freeze_audit cascade;
drop table if exists shedlock cascade;
